items.title: Steve "Ted" Brown Interview, 1958-04-22
items.q: Yes, I remember going there and hearing him play.

ctx.x: Do you remember him? Do you remember him?

Yes, I remember going there and hearing him play. He played a lot of piano. And he used to play singly, mostly. Sometimes he'd play with a little band. But most, many of them had violins. And as I said, the fruits. A different type of music entirely. You couldn't get the color. Did you hear him down here? No, I didn't hear him down here, but up there I did.
